customer_id.meaning: primary id of the buyer/homeowner profile (content hash or seed uuid)

full_name.meaning: buyer's full legal name as printed on the purchase or reservation documents

phone.meaning: primary mobile number on the buyer profile

email.meaning: email address on the buyer profile, lower case

date_of_birth.meaning: buyer's date of birth as shown on the identity document collected at contract

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the buyer's Social Security number collected for the purchase file

mailing_address.meaning: current mailing address on the buyer profile (street, city, state ZIP)

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the current mailing address

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the buyer profile was opened in the Calloway buyer portal

reservation_id.meaning: primary id of the Homesite Reservation Agreement

variant_name.meaning: premium class of the reserved homesite, the official tier name

community.meaning: Calloway community the homesite lies in

lot_number.meaning: site-plan lot number as printed on the community plat, e.g. CH-0147

lot_premium.meaning: lot premium of the reserved homesite as written on the reservation (0.00 for a homesite without premium)

occupancy_intent.meaning: buyer's stated occupancy intent on the reservation

prequal_letter_date.meaning: date printed on the most recent lender pre-qualification letter accepted for this reservation

reserved_date.meaning: date the reservation agreement was signed (day zero of every reservation window)

hold_expiry_date.meaning: last calendar day of the current hold; the hold lapses at the end of this day

extensions_used.meaning: number of hold extensions written on this reservation

swaps_used.meaning: number of homesite swaps written on this reservation

reinstatements_used.meaning: number of reinstatements written on this reservation

funds_on_hand.meaning: money currently held on the reservation; always equals the sum of reservation_funds deltas (in positive, out negative)

end_date.meaning: date the reservation converted, was released, expired or was withdrawn; empty while pending_deposit or held

homesite_event_id.meaning: primary id of the reservation ledger or notice row

reservation_id.meaning: reservation the row belongs to (foreign key -> homesite_reservations)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the homesite charter

amount.meaning: money moved by the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type (payments in, refunds/applications/retentions/returns out)

deposit_component.meaning: which deposit or fee the money belongs to

payment_method.meaning: how a received payment was made

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of a received payment exactly as printed on the Calloway receipt (check number, ACH trace or wire confirmation), e.g. RCPT-CH-20417

source_payment_ref.meaning: on refunds, applications, retentions and returns: the receipt number of the original payment the money came from

retention_reason.meaning: why money was retained by Calloway

event_date.meaning: date the payment posted, the refund/application/retention/return was booked, or the notice was sent

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification has passed; never goes back to false once true

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

purchase_id.meaning: primary id of the Home Purchase Agreement

variant_name.meaning: collection (home series) of the plan, the official tier name

reservation_id.meaning: Homesite Reservation converted into this agreement (foreign key -> homesite_reservations); empty when the homesite was not reserved first

lot_number.meaning: site-plan lot number of the homesite, e.g. CH-0147

plan_name.meaning: marketed plan and elevation name as printed on the agreement, e.g. The Bexley - Elevation C

base_price.meaning: base price of the plan on the community price sheet on the contract or latest plan-change date

lot_premium.meaning: lot premium written into the agreement (0.00 when none)

contract_price.meaning: base_price plus lot_premium; design studio options are not included

contract_date.meaning: date the buyer signed the agreement

inventory_home.meaning: true when the home was already complete (quick move-in) when the agreement was signed

financing_type.meaning: how the buyer is financing the purchase

sale_contingency.meaning: whether the agreement is contingent on the sale of the buyer's current home

contingency_deadline.meaning: contract date plus sale_contingency_days; empty when there is no contingency

construction_stage.meaning: current construction stage of the home as recorded by the construction manager

construction_start_date.meaning: date the foundation was started; empty before construction starts or on an inventory home

contract_completion_date.meaning: estimated completion date stated in the agreement at signing; never changes

estimated_completion_date.meaning: current estimated completion date, refreshed at each stage update

scheduled_closing_date.meaning: current scheduled closing date; empty until the closing date is set

closing_extensions_used.meaning: number of buyer-requested closing extensions written

lot_transfers_used.meaning: number of homesite transfers written on the agreement

earnest_money_held.meaning: deposits Calloway currently holds on the agreement; equals the sum of earnest_money deltas

buyer_charges_due.meaning: fees and per diem currently owed; equals the sum of buyer_charges deltas

incentive_balance.meaning: incentive dollars granted and not yet applied or revoked; equals the sum of incentive_credit deltas

end_date.meaning: closing date for a closed agreement, cancellation or termination date otherwise; empty while open

purchase_event_id.meaning: primary id of the agreement ledger or notice row

purchase_id.meaning: agreement the row belongs to (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the purchase charter

amount.meaning: money moved by the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

deposit_component.meaning: which deposit the money belongs to

payment_method.meaning: how a deposit was paid; internal_transfer for funds moved from a homesite reservation

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of a deposit payment exactly as printed on the Calloway receipt, e.g. RCPT-HP-55120; for a transfer, the receipt number of the original reservation payment

source_payment_ref.meaning: on refunds, forfeitures, applications and returns: the receipt number of the deposit payment the money came from

charge_type.meaning: kind of charge on a charge, waiver or collection row

charge_reference.meaning: charge number printed on the buyer statement, e.g. CHG-HP-3301

source_charge_ref.meaning: on waivers and collections: the charge number of the charge being waived or collected

period_start.meaning: first calendar day of a per diem period; empty for other rows

period_end.meaning: last calendar day of a per diem period; empty for other rows

incentive_type.meaning: which builder incentive an incentive row concerns

forfeiture_reason.meaning: why deposit money was retained by Calloway

event_date.meaning: date the row's money moved, the charge was assessed or waived, or the notice was sent

cancellation_request_id.meaning: primary id of the cancellation request

purchase_id.meaning: agreement the buyer asks to cancel (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

cancellation_basis.meaning: basis on which the buyer asks to cancel

received_date.meaning: date Calloway received the buyer's cancellation request

request_status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed once the buyer signs the cancellation, withdrawn if the buyer abandons it

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

selection_id.meaning: primary id of the design studio file

purchase_id.meaning: purchase agreement the file serves (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: Design Studio package of the file, the official tier name

status.meaning: design file lifecycle state (see design lifecycle)

opened_date.meaning: date the design studio file was opened

first_appointment_date.meaning: date of the first design appointment; empty until held

option_total.meaning: total of option lines and studio fees committed on the file; equals the sum of option_commitment deltas

option_deposit_held.meaning: option deposits currently held; equals the sum of option_deposit deltas

design_credit_balance.meaning: design credit available and unused; equals the sum of design_credit deltas

end_date.meaning: closing date for a delivered file or cancellation date for a cancelled file; empty while open

design_event_id.meaning: primary id of the design ledger or appointment row

selection_id.meaning: design studio file the row belongs to (foreign key -> design_selections)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the design charter

amount.meaning: money or price on the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

appointment_seq.meaning: sequence number of a design appointment on the file

appointment_channel.meaning: whether the appointment was held in the design studio or by video

appointment_hours.meaning: designer hours used in the appointment

option_line_ref.meaning: line number of an option line on the selection sheet, e.g. OPT-CH0147-012

option_code.meaning: Calloway design studio catalog code of the option, e.g. KIT-QTZ-L3

option_category.meaning: category of an option or studio fee line; the first three are structural-class lines, the next five finish lines, the rest fee lines

selection_channel.meaning: where an option line was selected

source_line_ref.meaning: on removals and credit applications: the line number of the option line concerned

change_order_number.meaning: change order number on the file, e.g. CO-2; empty for lines selected before the first change order

change_order_reason.meaning: why a change order was written

construction_stage_at_event.meaning: construction stage on the purchase agreement when the row was written

payment_method.meaning: how an option deposit was paid

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of an option deposit payment as printed on the Calloway receipt, e.g. RCPT-DS-30871

source_payment_ref.meaning: on refunds, forfeitures, applications and returns: receipt number of the option deposit payment concerned

refund_reason.meaning: why option deposit money was refunded

credit_reference.meaning: credit memo number of a design credit grant, e.g. DCM-0412

event_date.meaning: date of the appointment, selection, change order, payment, refund, credit or forfeiture

lock_id.meaning: primary id of the rate lock

purchase_id.meaning: purchase agreement the loan finances (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: lock term of the rate lock, the official tier name

status.meaning: rate lock lifecycle state (see lock lifecycle)

loan_program.meaning: loan program the lock is on

loan_amount.meaning: current loan amount on the lock

ltv_pct.meaning: loan amount divided by the purchase price, as a percent, on the latest pricing

qualifying_credit_score.meaning: qualifying credit score from the credit report on file at request

qualifying_dti_pct.meaning: qualifying debt-to-income ratio from the loan application at request

par_rate.meaning: par rate on the lock desk rate sheet for the program on the request date (or the latest terms-change date)

locked_rate.meaning: interest rate currently locked; empty until confirmed

lock_date.meaning: date the lock desk confirmed the lock; empty until confirmed

lock_expiration_date.meaning: last calendar day the lock is in force; empty until confirmed

extension_days_used.meaning: total calendar days of extensions written

expired_date.meaning: the day after the last day of the most recent expired lock period; empty if the lock never expired

lock_fee_held.meaning: upfront lock fee currently held; equals the sum of lock_fee deltas

charges_due.meaning: lock charges currently owed; equals the sum of lock_charges deltas

end_date.meaning: funding, cancellation or withdrawal date; empty while open

lock_event_id.meaning: primary id of the lock ledger or notice row

lock_id.meaning: rate lock the row belongs to (foreign key -> rate_locks)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the lock charter

amount.meaning: money moved by the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

payment_method.meaning: how the upfront fee was paid

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of the upfront fee payment as printed on the Calloway Home Mortgage receipt, e.g. CHM-RCPT-90412

source_payment_ref.meaning: on credits, refunds and forfeitures: receipt number of the fee payment concerned

charge_reference.meaning: charge number printed on the lock confirmation, e.g. LCK-CHG-7781

source_charge_ref.meaning: on waivers and collections: charge number of the charge concerned

extension_days.meaning: calendar days added by the extension a charge belongs to

waiver_reason.meaning: why a lock charge was waived

refund_reason.meaning: why the upfront fee was refunded

forfeiture_reason.meaning: why the upfront fee was retained

event_date.meaning: date the payment posted, the charge was assessed or waived, the money moved or the notice was sent

coverage_id.meaning: primary id of one owner's HomeCare warranty coverage on one home

purchase_id.meaning: purchase agreement under which Calloway built and sold the home (foreign key -> purchase_agreements); identifies the home for every owner

variant_name.meaning: HomeCare program of the home, the official tier name

owner_type.meaning: whether this homeowner bought from Calloway or from a previous owner

prior_coverage_id.meaning: previous owner's coverage on the same home (foreign key -> warranty_coverages); empty for the original buyer

ownership_start_date.meaning: closing date for the original buyer; deed (recording) date for a subsequent owner

coverage_start_date.meaning: original closing date of the home; the same for every owner

workmanship_end_date.meaning: last covered day of the workmanship period

systems_end_date.meaning: last covered day of the systems period

structural_end_date.meaning: last covered day of the structural period

roof_leak_end_date.meaning: last covered day of the roof leak period

charges_due.meaning: warranty charges owed; equals the sum of homeowner_charges deltas

payouts_owed.meaning: approved payouts not yet paid; equals the sum of homeowner_payouts deltas

end_date.meaning: date the coverage was transferred or expired; empty while active

warranty_event_id.meaning: primary id of the warranty claim, service, charge or payout row

coverage_id.meaning: coverage the row belongs to (foreign key -> warranty_coverages)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the warranty charter

claim_item_ref.meaning: item number of a warranty service request item exactly as printed on the service request, e.g. WSR-20417-03

defect_category.meaning: category of the reported condition; maps to its coverage basis in the warranty charter

report_channel.meaning: how a claim item was reported

emergency_type.meaning: emergency condition reported with an item, or none

response_hours.meaning: hours from the emergency report to technician arrival

measured_width_in.meaning: measured crack width or vertical displacement for crack items

coverage_basis.meaning: coverage period an approval rests on

denial_reason.meaning: why a claim item was denied

callback_seq.meaning: 0 for the original decision or repair of an item, 1 and up for callbacks

appointment_date.meaning: date of a booked or missed appointment

walkthrough_type.meaning: which walkthrough or included check visit

charge_reference.meaning: charge number printed on the homeowner invoice, e.g. WCH-5512

source_charge_ref.meaning: on payments and waivers: charge number of the charge concerned

payment_method.meaning: how a warranty charge was paid

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of a warranty charge payment

waiver_reason.meaning: why a warranty charge was waived

payout_type.meaning: kind of payout to the homeowner

payout_reference.meaning: payout number of an approved payout, e.g. WPO-1187

source_payout_ref.meaning: on payout issues: payout number paid

nights.meaning: nights reimbursed on a relocation payout

amount.meaning: money on the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

event_date.meaning: date the item was reported, inspected, decided, scheduled, repaired, charged, paid or the walkthrough held

policy_id.meaning: primary id of the homeowners policy or quote

purchase_id.meaning: purchase agreement of the insured home (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: HomeShield program of the policy, the official tier name

policy_number.meaning: policy number printed on the declarations page, e.g. HS-778120

coverage_a.meaning: dwelling coverage (Coverage A) currently on the policy

coastal_wind_zone.meaning: true when the home's community is a coastal wind community

auto_bundled.meaning: true when an auto policy is placed with Calloway Insurance Agency

autopay.meaning: true when automatic payments are set up

term_premium.meaning: annual premium for the current term after surcharges and discounts

binder_date.meaning: date the binder was issued; empty while quoted

effective_date.meaning: date coverage begins (the closing date of the home); the scheduled closing date until bound and effective

expiration_date.meaning: last day of the current policy term

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the policy was cancelled; empty otherwise

premium_balance.meaning: premium and fees billed and not yet paid or credited; equals the sum of premium_due deltas

end_date.meaning: cancellation effective date or expiration date of a non-renewed policy; empty while bound or in force

insurance_event_id.meaning: primary id of the policy billing, claim or notice row

policy_id.meaning: policy the row belongs to (foreign key -> insurance_policies)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the insurance charter

amount.meaning: money on the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

bill_reference.meaning: bill number printed on the premium notice, e.g. HSB-778120-03

due_date.meaning: date a bill line is due

payment_method.meaning: how a premium payment was made

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of a premium payment

source_bill_ref.meaning: bill number a payment is applied to

claim_number.meaning: claim number assigned to a reported loss, e.g. HSC-30418

event_date.meaning: date billed, received, credited, reported or sent

lease_id.meaning: primary id of the SunPath solar lease

purchase_id.meaning: purchase agreement of the home the system is on (foreign key -> purchase_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: system size of the lease, the official tier name

agreement_number.meaning: lease agreement number printed on the lease, e.g. SPL-44120

prepaid.meaning: true when the whole lease was prepaid at signing

autopay.meaning: true when automatic payments are set up

paper_billing.meaning: true when the lessee receives mailed paper bills

install_date.meaning: date the system was installed; empty before installation

first_bill_date.meaning: date of the first monthly bill; empty before PTO

monthly_payment.meaning: current monthly lease payment before autopay credit

lease_balance.meaning: amount billed and not yet paid or credited; equals the sum of lease_balance deltas

end_date.meaning: transfer, buyout or termination date; empty while open

solar_event_id.meaning: primary id of the lease billing, production, service or notice row

lease_id.meaning: lease the row belongs to (foreign key -> solar_leases)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the solar charter

amount.meaning: money on the row, always positive; direction is given by event_type

bill_reference.meaning: bill number printed on the lease statement, e.g. SPL-44120-0613

due_date.meaning: due date of a bill line

payment_method.meaning: how a lease payment was made

payment_reference.meaning: receipt number of a lease payment

source_bill_ref.meaning: bill number a payment is applied to

lease_year.meaning: lease year counted from the permission-to-operate date

actual_kwh.meaning: metered production in the lease year

guaranteed_kwh.meaning: guaranteed production for the lease year

event_date.meaning: date billed, received, credited, reconciled, visited or sent
